CAMERA_HELP_BASIC_PRIVATE:
Disables the camera's audio and video connections for privacy. Turn privacy mode off to watch video again.

This button sends the command immediately; you do not need to press Apply.
CAMERA_HELP_BASIC_NIGHTVISION:
Infrared illumination provides a black-and-white image in the dark.

Auto: the camera selects night mode based on ambient light. On: night vision stays on. Off: infrared night vision is disabled.
CAMERA_HELP_BASIC_FLIP: Flips the camera image. Use this if the camera is mounted upside down.
CAMERA_HELP_BASIC_OSD: Adds the date and time directly to the camera image. This video timestamp is separate from reading update times in this app.
CAMERA_HELP_BASIC_ANTI_FLICKER: Reduces flicker caused by artificial lighting. Select your local mains frequency: 50 Hz or 60 Hz. Off disables flicker correction.
CAMERA_HELP_MOTION_SWITCH:
Enables motion alarms. Turning this off stops these alarm notifications in Smart Life.

Sensitivity is configured separately. The detection area and human filter determine which events are included.
CAMERA_HELP_MOTION_SENSITIVITY:
Higher sensitivity lets the camera detect smaller movements.

Low: responds to substantial movement and helps reduce false alarms. Medium: balances detection and false alarms. High: responds to small movements.

Low sensitivity does not disable detection. Sound sensitivity is configured separately.
CAMERA_HELP_HUMANOID_FILTER:
Filters motion events to notify only when a person is detected. Smart Life calls this Human Detection (Only Human Events). It detects a human silhouette, not the person's identity.

Tuya describes this parameter as a human filter. The SDK allows processing on the device, but support depends on hardware and firmware. Our connection does not report Sleep Cam's subscription terms: the presence of a switch does not establish whether the feature is paid or free. Check your camera's terms in Smart Life.
CAMERA_HELP_MOTION_AREA_SWITCH: Limits detection to a selected part of the image. Smart Life calls this Activity Area. Set the zone using Detection area.
CAMERA_HELP_DECIBEL_SWITCH: Enables camera sound-event detection. In Smart Life, sound sensitivity can be set separately. Sound and motion detection work independently.
CAMERA_HELP_DECIBEL_SENSITIVITY:
Sets sound-detection sensitivity. Higher sensitivity lets the camera detect quieter sounds.

Low: less sensitive. High: detects weaker sounds. This setting does not change motion sensitivity.
CAMERA_HELP_SIREN_SWITCH: Turns the camera's audible siren on or off. Siren control is separate from motion and sound detection.
CAMERA_HELP_RECORD_SWITCH:
Enables recording by the camera onto a working, inserted memory card. Recording is unavailable without a ready card.

A saved On value alone does not confirm recording is currently active. This is separate from live video and the Smart Life cloud archive.
CAMERA_HELP_RECORD_MODE:
Events only: records to the card when motion is detected. Continuous: records to the card continuously.

Both modes require a ready memory card and recording to be enabled.
CAMERA_HELP_RECORD_LOOP: Enables loop recording: when the memory card is full, new recordings replace the oldest ones.
CAMERA_HELP_SD_STORGE: The camera reports total, used, and free memory card capacity in its own format.
CAMERA_HELP_SD_STATUS:
The camera reports whether the card is ready, has an error, lacks free space, is being formatted, or is not inserted.

Recording is available only when the card status is Ready. An unknown status does not confirm readiness.
CAMERA_HELP_SD_FORMAT:
Formatting deletes all recordings on the memory card. The app asks for confirmation before sending the command.

Unavailable without a card, with unknown card status, or while formatting is already in progress.
CAMERA_HELP_SD_FORMAT_STATE:
The camera reports formatting progress or errors. Tuya documents positive values as progress; −2000 means formatting, −2001 means formatting failed, −2002 means no card, and −2003 means a card error.

This is a camera reading, not a button to start formatting.

THE_GATEWAY_IS_CONFIGURED_FOR_LOCAL_CHIL: The gateway is configured for local child-device connections. Open each child's card for its readings and controls.
MAP_LOCAL_PARAMETERS_AFTER_SAVING: Connection saved. Match the device's local parameters to Tuya functions to show its controls and readings.
THE_SERVICE_RETURNED_A_DIFFERENT_GROUP: The service returned a different group.
COMMANDS_ARE_SENT_TO_MEMBERS_IN_SEQUENCE: Commands are sent to members in sequence. Partial failures are shown separately; acknowledgement is not a state reading.
COULD_NOT_READ_THE_NETWORK_LIST: Could not read the network list.
THE_SERVICE_RETURNED_UNEXPECTED_NETWORK_: The service returned unexpected network data.
OBSERVATION_STOPPED_BECAUSE_THE_TAB_IS_H: Observation stopped because the tab is hidden. The last result can still be saved.
TUYA_DISCOVERY_REQUEST_SENT: Tuya discovery request sent. Waiting for device responses.
DEVICE_ANNOUNCEMENTS_AND_NEIGHBORS_ON_TH: Device announcements and neighbors on the server's network.
REFRESH_PRIVATE_IPV4_NETWORK_LIST: No private IPv4 networks found. Connect the server to the required network and refresh the list.
PASSIVELY_RECEIVE_TUYA_MDNS_AND_SSDP_ANN: Passively receive Tuya, mDNS, and SSDP announcements from the selected subnet and read its neighbor-table entries. The discovery button sends only a standard Tuya discovery request through the selected interface so devices can respond; it does not change their settings or state.
ZIGBEE_HAS_NO_IP_OF_ITS_OWN: Zigbee has no IP of its own. A network gateway may appear here, but these announcements cannot prove it is a Zigbee gateway or identify its children. No packets does not mean a device is off.
THESE_ARE_HOME_NETWORK_ANNOUNCEMENTS_NOT: These are home-network announcements, not all traffic between devices. Device types are shown only from service announcements. Raw packets, keys, and TXT/HTTP payloads are not retained. Results are temporary for up to 15 minutes, then can be exported for further analysis.
OBSERVATION_CONTINUES_ON_THE_REMAINING_P: . Observation continues on the remaining ports.
THE_256_DEVICE_LIMIT_WAS_REACHED: The 256-device limit was reached. Save the report and start a new observation.
SEARCH_BY_IP_MAC_ID_OR_SERVICE: Search by IP, MAC, ID, or service
WAITING_FOR_DEVICE_ANNOUNCEMENTS: Waiting for device announcements. You can request Tuya announcements.
LAST_200_EVENTS_TIME_SENDER_PORT_AND_REC: Last 200 events: time, sender, port, and recognized protocol only.
SCHEDULE_HELP_RHYTHM_MODE: Change lighting throughout the day: choose weekdays and points with the desired time, color, and brightness. The bulb runs the saved schedule.
SCHEDULE_HELP_RANDOM_TIMING: Set time windows during which the light turns on and off randomly, creating the impression that someone is home.
SCHEDULE_HELP_WAKEUP_MODE: Light gradually brightens before wake-up. Choose days, time, transition duration, and final brightness.
SCHEDULE_HELP_SLEEP_MODE: Light gradually dims before sleep. Choose days, start time, and transition duration.
CREATE_A_SCHEDULE_OR_KEEP_THE_ORIGINAL_D: Create a schedule or keep the original data unchanged.
THE_CURRENT_VALUE_WAS_NOT_RECOGNIZED_AS_: The current value was not recognized as a standard schedule. Original data is preserved.
WITH_NO_SELECTED_DAYS_A_POINT_RUNS_ONCE: With no selected days, a point runs once. Disabled points are saved but do not run.
SET_WEEKDAYS_AND_ENABLED_STATUS_SEPARATE: Set weekdays and enabled status separately for each point on the next step.
ADD_A_POINT_TO_SET_THE_TIME_AND: Add a point to set the time and light.
FORMAT_NOT_RECOGNIZED: Format not recognized. Original data is unchanged.
THE_BROWSER_COULD_NOT_SAVE_THIS_CONNECTI: The browser could not save this connection. Check storage permissions.
COMMANDS_THAT_CHANGE_THE_LIGHT_IN_TIME_W: Commands that change the light in time with music. Synchronization requires an audio source that sends these commands.
COMMAND_FOR_AN_IMMEDIATE_OR_SMOOTH_LIGHT: Command for an immediate or smooth lighting change. Current state is shown in the color and brightness controls.
LIGHT_SCENES_SAVED_ON_SERVER: Scenes are saved on the server. Apply sends the preset to this bulb.
LIGHT_SCENE_NAME_TAKEN: A scene with this name already exists.
WHICH_STATE_TO_RESTORE_AFTER_ELECTRICAL_: Which state to restore after electrical power is disconnected and restored. This is a setting, not the relay's current status.
TURNS_THE_SWITCH_BUTTON_BACKLIGHT_ON_OR_: Turns the switch button backlight on or off.
COUNTDOWN_UNTIL_THE_SWITCH_CHANGES_STATE: Countdown until the switch changes state. Set the time in seconds.
AFTER_TURNING_ON_THE_SWITCH_TURNS_OFF_AU: After turning on, the switch turns off automatically after the configured time, for example one minute. This setting is sent as a string; this device's API does not describe its format.
LINKED_DEVICES_ARE_ADDED_IN_SMART_LIFE: Linked devices are added in Smart Life. The bulb's on/off setting is available here; managing bindings is not implemented yet.
THE_DEVICE_DID_NOT_SPECIFY_A_UNIT: The device did not specify a unit.
VALUE_DOES_NOT_MATCH_THE_ALLOWED_STEP: Value does not match the allowed step.
COLOR_MUST_CONTAIN_HUE_0360_AND_SATURATI: Color must contain hue 0–360 and saturation/brightness 0–1000.
THIS_CONTROL_FORMAT_IS_NOT_SUPPORTED_YET: This control format is not supported yet.
UP_TO_16_PARAMETERS_CAN_BE_APPLIED_AT: Up to 16 parameters can be applied at once.
THE_SERVICE_RETURNED_AN_UNEXPECTED_LIST: The service returned an unexpected list.
THE_LIST_IS_TOO_LARGE: The list is too large. Use the REST API for this inventory.
FILL_IN_ALL_FIELDS_OF_THE_DEVICE_COMMAND: Fill in all fields of the device command.
EFFECT_VALUE_IS_OUTSIDE_THE_ALLOWED_RANG: Effect value is outside the allowed range or step.
MANUFACTURER_DATA_EXCEEDS_THE_ALLOWED_SI: Manufacturer data exceeds the allowed size.
COULD_NOT_READ_THE_HOME_STRUCTURE: Could not read the home structure.
NUMERIC_ID_UNICODE_ALIAS_OR_EXACT_NAME_R: Numeric ID, Unicode alias, or exact name reference: name:Socket
SMART_LIFE_DOES_NOT_IDENTIFY_THE_SELECTE: Smart Life does not identify the selected device as a gateway.
SMART_LIFE_PROVIDED_NO_USABLE_KEYS: Smart Life provided no usable keys. Refresh devices or enter the key manually.
TUYA_DID_NOT_ALLOCATE_A_VIDEO_STREAM: Tuya did not allocate a video stream. Check camera connectivity and video access for this connection.
TUYA_PROVIDED_NO_USABLE_KEYS_TO_VERIFY_T: Tuya provided no usable keys to verify the device.
TUYA_DID_NOT_PROVIDE_AN_ACCESSIBLE_HTTPS: Tuya did not provide an accessible HTTPS video stream for this camera.
THE_DEVICE_ADDRESS_IS_AMBIGUOUS_OR_CHANG: The device address is ambiguous or changed. Search again.
ACCOUNT_CHANGED_RESTART_POLL: The account changed. Start a new polling session.
ACCOUNT_CHANGED_RESTART_GATEWAY_SEARCH: The account changed. Search for the gateway again.
VERIFICATION_TIMED_OUT: Verification timed out. Check the device IP and availability, then try again.
SELECTED_NETWORK_UNAVAILABLE: The selected network is no longer available. Refresh the network list.
THE_SELECTED_NETWORK_CHANGED: The selected network changed. Search again.
TUYA_DID_NOT_CONFIRM_THAT_THE_SELECTED_D: Tuya did not confirm that the selected device is a gateway.
THE_PREVIEW_DATA_CHANGED: The preview data changed. Search again.
LOCAL_POLLING_REQUIRES_THE_DEVICE_OR_GAT: Local polling requires the device or gateway IP, local key, and protocol version.
SELECT_A_CONNECTED_ACCOUNT_FOR_CLOUD_POL: Select a connected account for cloud polling.
VERIFICATION_REQUIRES_THE_DEVICE_OR_GATE: Verification requires the device or gateway's private home-network IP (10.x, 172.16–31.x, or 192.168.x).
THE_DEVICE_RECORD_CHANGED: The device record changed. Search again.
A_ZIGBEE_DEVICES_KEY_IS_CONFIGURED_ON_IT: A Zigbee device's key is configured on its confirmed gateway.
THE_SMART_LIFE_KEY_CHANGED: The Smart Life key changed. Verify the gateway again.
THE_TUYA_KEY_CHANGED: The Tuya key changed. Search for the gateway again.
BUTTON_PULSE_WITHOUT_AN_INVENTED_STATE: Button / pulse, without an invented state
NETWORK_OBSERVATION_FINISHED: Network observation finished. You can start it again.
COULD_NOT_SEND_A_DISCOVERY_REQUEST_TO_TH: Could not send a discovery request to the home network.
COULD_NOT_SYNC_SMART_LIFE: Could not sync Smart Life. The previous structure is preserved; check the connection and try again.
NO_KEY_WAS_VERIFIED: No key was verified. Check the device IP and home-network availability. You can enter the key manually.
THE_DEVICE_ANNOUNCEMENT_DOES_NOT_MATCH_T: The device announcement does not match the selected network.
POLLING_ENDED_OR_EXPIRED: Polling ended or expired. Start again.
YOU_CAN_REQUEST_ANNOUNCEMENTS_AGAIN_AFTE: You can request announcements again after 10 seconds.
THE_DEVICE_CONNECTION_OR_FUNCTIONS_CHANG: The device connection or functions changed. Start setup again.
KEY_DISCOVERY_SUPPORTS_PROTOCOLS_3_33_5: Key discovery supports protocols 3.3–3.5. A 3.1 response does not verify the key.
KEY_DISCOVERY_REQUIRES_A_SELECTED_ACCOUN: Key discovery requires a selected account and local mode, without a manually entered key.
THE_PREVIOUS_POLLING_REQUEST_IS_STILL_RU: The previous polling request is still running.
TUYA_PORT_7000_RECEPTION_IS_NOT_READY_OR: Tuya port 7000 reception is not ready or the port is busy.
TUYA_ANNOUNCEMENT_PORT_UNAVAILABLE: Tuya announcement reception is unavailable. Check port 7000.
ANOTHER_DEVICE_IS_BEING_VERIFIED: Another device is being verified. Wait for it to finish.
ANOTHER_GATEWAY_IS_BEING_VERIFIED: Another gateway is being verified. Wait for it to finish.
THE_DISCOVERY_RESULT_EXPIRED: The discovery result expired. Find the gateway again.
TUYA_AND_THE_LOCAL_DATABASE_DISAGREE_ON_: Tuya and the local database disagree on the gateway relationship. Check the connection.
THE_GATEWAY_CONNECTION_IS_ALREADY_VERIFI: The gateway connection is already verified. Save it or start a new polling session.
TOO_MANY_POSSIBLE_KEYS: Too many possible keys. Identify the gateway in Smart Life or enter the key manually.
TOO_MANY_NETWORK_OBSERVATIONS: Too many network observations. Close the previous page.
TOO_MANY_OPEN_POLLING_SESSIONS: Too many open polling sessions. Close the previous one.
SET_UP_AND_ENABLE_THE_DEVICE_OR_GATEWAYS: Set up and enable the device or gateway's local connection first.
POLL_THE_DEVICE_FIRST_CAPABILITIES_ARE_C: Poll the device first; capabilities are created on saving.
THE_EXISTING_RECORD_IS_DISABLED_OR_HAS_A: The existing record is disabled or has a different connection type.
THE_TUYA_FUNCTION_SCHEMA_CHANGED: The Tuya function schema changed. Start setup again.
THE_DEVICE_TYPE_CHANGED: The device type changed. Search again.
CONTROL_IS_AVAILABLE_ONLY_FOR_UNAMBIGUOU: Control is available only for unambiguously verified Tuya DPs.
THE_DEVICE_NO_LONGER_VERIFIES_THE_CONNEC: The device no longer verifies the connection. Search again.
TUYA_REPORTS_THIS_DEVICE_OFFLINE_CODE_20: Tuya reports this device offline (code 2001). Command rejected.
THE_DEVICE_WAS_NOT_FOUND_ON_THE_SELECTED: The device was not found on the selected network. Check the network and device power.
TUYA_DOES_NOT_IDENTIFY_THIS_DEVICE_AS_A: Tuya does not identify this device as a camera.
THE_DEVICE_HAS_ALREADY_BEEN_ADDED_TO_YOU: The device has already been added to your home.
THE_DEVICE_GATEWAY_CHANGED: The device gateway changed. Search again.
THIS_ZIGBEE_DEVICES_GATEWAY_IS_UNKNOWN: This Zigbee device's gateway is unknown. Select and configure its gateway first.
THIS_SETUP_IS_FOR_DEVICES_WHOSE_FUNCTION: This setup is for devices whose functions are not yet configured.
DONE_SENDS_THE_CHANGES_TO_THE_DEVICE: Done sends the changes to the device. Cancel keeps the previous settings.
SAVE_SENDS_THE_SELECTED_AREA_TO_THE_CAME: Save sends the selected area to the camera.
BYTES_APPLY_AUTOMATICALLY_SUFFIX: bytes. Valid changes are sent automatically.
CAMERA_HELP_MOTION_AREA:
Sets the part of the image to monitor. Move and resize the red frame in the editor.

Save sends the selected area to the camera. Enable Limit detection area to use this zone.
WHILE_THE_CARD_IS_VISIBLE_THE_SERVER_REQ: While the card is visible, the server requests readings every 5 seconds. The card checks saved data every second. Refresh status requests readings immediately. Setting changes are sent automatically.
THE_SERVICE_CONTINUOUSLY_RECEIVES_TUYA_N: The service continuously receives Tuya network announcements. This shows the configured IP, last announcement, and address changes for the device or its gateway.
THE_SHARED_RECEIVER_ALSO_RUNS_WHILE_CARD: The shared receiver also runs while cards are closed. Announcements do not confirm switch state, and missing announcements do not mean the device is off. The configured IP is not changed automatically.
GLOBAL_ANNOUNCEMENT_RECEPTION_IS_DISABLE: Global announcement reception is disabled in the service settings.
TUYA_RECEPTION_RUNS_CONTINUOUSLY: Tuya reception runs continuously. A new observation reuses announcements already received from the selected network and adds mDNS, SSDP, and the neighbor table. Stopping an observation leaves the shared receiver running.
DASHBOARD_LAYOUT_INSTRUCTIONS: Drag above or below a card to insert it. On touch screens, select a card and then a spot.
DASHBOARD_LAYOUT_LOAD_FAILED: Could not load the saved layout.
DASHBOARD_LAYOUT_SAVE_FAILED: Could not save the layout. Your edits are still here.
CHOOSE_COMBINED_MEMBER: Choose a device to open its settings.
COMBINED_DEVICES_HELP: A combined device has one dashboard card. Control its members together or open them individually.
NO_COMBINED_DEVICES: There are no combined devices yet.
COMBINED_CARD_PREVIEW_HELP: This is how the combination will look on your dashboard. Controls are disabled in the preview.
COMBINED_WIRING_HELP: Choose the switch channel that physically supplies power to each device. These links are recorded manually.
COMBINED_WIRING_LOOKUP_FAILED: Could not load some relay channels.
COMBINED_LOADING_WIRING_CHANNELS: Checking selected devices for relay channels…
COMBINED_NO_WIRING_CHANNELS: Select a device with a relay channel to record wiring.
COMBINED_WIRING_SOURCE_NOT_IN_GROUP: The power source must be part of the combination.
COMBINED_WIRING_INVALID_CHANNEL: The selected device does not expose that relay channel.
DISSOLVE_COMBINATION_QUESTION: Return the members to separate cards?
DEVICE_TRANSLATION_FALLBACK_HELP: Enter display text for each language. A blank field uses the original name or alias.
DEVICE_TRANSLATION_OUTDATED: This name or alias has changed. Reload the device and try again.
